verdict.rationale: Simular documents that Sai works across desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals, and that it keeps running after you close the laptop, only pinging you via iMessage or Telegram when it needs you or before sensitive steps. That is the 'no babysitting' behaviour the story asks for. Self-healing saved skills and scheduled reruns that reportedly grow more reliable add to the reliability claim. All of this is vendor-claimed, though. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that multi-app tasks actually complete reliably, and published success-rate figures (the workflow templates mention success rates but no numbers appear in evidence).
